messages.subject: Sutherland v Vantage - draft Particulars
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

My draft Particulars of Claim are attached. I've pleaded the debt and the wrongful termination, with the loss particularised by reference to the guaranteed minimum and cross-referring to the Schedule of Loss. Happy to discuss the pleading of clause 13.5 - I think we should add it expressly in the next pass.

Harriet Stanford
Eldon Chambers
